reason: PURE. I noticed first the bisglycinate with no oxide, which is what I need because citrate upsets my stomach, and the batch QR is a nice touch. But it is a brand with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal, and I stay with Thorne or Pure Encapsulations for something I take every day.
objection: I do not know this brand and there is no NSF or USP seal. A lab report the company links to itself is not the same as a third party certification I already trust.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box, or a few hundred honest verified reviews, at a price close to what I pay for Thorne.
